component.name: OnDemandPasswordTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "checkPassword" end sub
sub checkPassword() password = m.top.password m.top.password = "" if m.top.uri = "" m.top.result = { matched: false, message: "Configure a valid Server URL first." } return end if if password = "" m.top.result = { matched: false, message: "Enter a password." } return end if
transfer = createObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.setCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") transfer.initClientCertificates() transfer.setUrl(m.top.uri) port = createObject("roMessagePort") transfer.setMessagePort(port) if not transfer.asyncGetToString() m.top.result = { matched: false, message: "The password request could not be started." } return end if event = wait(10000, port) if event = invalid transfer.asyncCancel() m.top.result = { matched: false, message: "The password request timed out." } return end if if type(event) <> "roUrlEvent" transfer.asyncCancel() m.top.result = { matched: false, message: "The password request returned an unexpected network event." } return end if code = event.getResponseCode() if code < 200 or code >= 300 m.top.result = { matched: false, message: "The password request failed with HTTP " + code.toStr() + "." } return end if if event.getString() = password m.top.result = { matched: true, message: "On Demand is unlocked for this session." } else m.top.result = { matched: false, message: "The password did not match." } end if end sub
